# CentralityAsControlInput

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Treating node centrality metrics (e.g., betweenness, eigenvector) as controllable state variables that can be steered via external inputs or edge weight modifications. Bridges network analysis with actuation, allowing iNEST/TCC systems to use centrality as a lever for optimizing communication and computation paths.
